mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% over the prior 4 months reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns in the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Rising inflationary bias in the Fed’s policy framework
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-rate hike period (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed high-inflation episodes.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the CPIAUCSL exceeds +0.5% in a month following a negative monthly pay growth (PAYEMS), it indicates wage deflation and prompts the market to anticipate future rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: Early-stage wage-price decoupling in labor market stress
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically superior to a neutral benchmark (mean 0, SD of returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals labor market strength, which reduces recession risk and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns in the following 5 trading days.
regime_hint: Expanding labor market with accelerating job creation
failure_condition: During confirmed expansion regimes, 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 10% in a month coinciding with a sharp drop in retail sales proxy (HOUST) below 1,700 units indicates weakening aggregate demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Concurrent weakness in manufacturing and retail demand signals
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05) during analogous demand weakness episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A multi-month decline in inventory investment (not directly observable in the provided proxies, but as a structural signal) combined with a sustained drop in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 202 suggests easing supply constraints, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not superior to a supply-neutral period (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% for the first time in a rolling quarter, it often precedes a labor market tightening cycle that raises risk premia, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 AND UNRATE_prev > 4.0 in the same quarter
regime_hint: Transition from labor market slack to tightening
failure_condition: During such transitions, 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in retail activity (HOUST) above 1,800 units and a decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) below 110 triggers a shift in demand composition toward services, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
regime_hint: Shift from manufacturing to services dominance in economic activity
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10) during analogous regime changes.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of declining consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 202 with no change in the FEDFUNDS rate (FEDFUNDS <= previous month) suggests the Fed is on hold, which often precedes a flattening yield curve and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Neutral monetary policy stance with deflationary pressures
failure_condition: During such policy holds, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10).
